title: Clear as Mud
subtitle: podcast, host & producer
body: I produced and hosted 27 episodes of Clear as Mud, mudstack’s interview series with game, XR and creative-technology leaders (2022–2023). I owned speaker research and outreach, scheduling, production and distribution alongside blog and webinar work.
note: 27 episodes produced and hosted, from my first-hand work history; the show’s public catalog also contains episodes outside my tenure.
